The plate looks like a square dinner plate of about 26 cm. The food on it is a pile of fresh spinach with a few shredded carrots, plus a serving of brown rice cooked with tomato sauce and wilted spinach.

I estimate the spinach salad at about 50 g, roughly 15 kcal. The rice dish covers an area of about 12x12 cm and is perhaps 2 cm thick, which comes to about 200 g. Cooked brown rice with tomato and a little oil runs about 1.4 kcal/g, so that is about 280 kcal.

Total is about 250 g and 300 kcal.
